findings.finding: FY2026 FCF guide (EUR 100-300m) needs Q4 FCF of +140m to +340m after 9M -40m; Q4 2025 delivered about +219m (FY2025 266m less 9M2025 47m) and Q3 2026 already +260m, so the cash guide looks reachable and the release is unlikely to cut it.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: FCF is the line this stock has reacted to: the 2025-10-28 FCF-guide raise ad-hoc moved +6.25%; FY2025 FCF above guide (3 Mar 2026). A reconfirmation has moved little (Aug 2026 -0.26%).
findings.why_not_priced: Arithmetic on public numbers sitting inside a guide reconfirmed three weeks ago; it is priced, so 0. It would only matter if the company changed the range, for which I found no source either way.
